title: tacz VR questcraft port
description: an attempt to port tacz to questcraft
body:
an attempt to port the forge version of the TacZ VR (Vivecraft) made by virtualbober (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/tacz-vr-vivecraft)
this all-in-one modpack features some optimization mods as well as pre configured gun mod named tacz from said modpack all in neat modpack which can be directly installed on your headset via the mods button

theres currently no gun mod/modpacks which would work on standalone questcraft,this modpack shall fix this issue!

i do not guarantee that it works but worth a shot and try,any modifications are EXTREMELY welcome!

heres the description from og modpack by virtualbobber as it is a port of his modpack to fabric:

This is a simple pack that allows partial support of TacZ in VR, build using Guncraft VR (Vivecraft) mod, with few QOL changes.

Autoreload: you no longer need to bind any keys anywhere to reload the gun, it will automatically reload after the mag is empty.
Aim: you can use ironsight to aim, all the bullets should hit the target
Shooting while running: there is no longer stutter when trying to shoot while moving forward
There are still small issues: 

The bullets fly from the postion of Head and not the position of the controller, which may cause issues if the player is sitting and too close to the target
Minigun model is broken
Overall the inaccuracy of guns is set to 0 which makes them fell like laser when playing on flatscreen
